$provenance.target: production HQ, the test organisation's standing low-role person; fixtures in mate-hq docs/architecture/testing.md
steps: Have the standing low-role person's browser profile (nonmember) signed in to Zerops and set HQ_LIVE_PROFILES to the directory holding it.
Create an absolute empty directory outside the checkout and run GOTOOLCHAIN=local go run ./cmd/live --prod --profile nonmember --record-answers <dir>.
The recorder opens one door session of the test organisation as that person and asks the refusal body of GET /api/activity?limit=1.

It writes the public form: booleans, nulls and the kept paths of its answer entry stay as HQ sent them; every other string becomes v1, v2, … and every other number 1, 2, … in the order HQ sent them, the same value the same placeholder in the file; a replaced value is replaced inside kept strings and object keys too; it refuses to write when the file still contains the organisations' ids and names, the person's user id, the HQ host or the Zerops app domain.
It ends the session with DELETE /api/session before writing, and writes every answer or none; copy the files to recordings/answers/.
